title: Reconcile proliferative gland populations and study overlap in the Human Endometrial Cell Atlas
question: Can the public annotation and donor metadata establish a separate, biologically comparable glandular case-control population?
scope: Published metadata and cell-count tables from the HECA release. No individual expression outcomes.
steps: Identify the proliferative gland states from the authors' anatomical definitions.
Audit published metadata, library links, hormone and phase evidence, cell-count denominators, and study overlap.
Verify the coverage independently and document feasible contrasts or the precise missing keys.
deliverables: Aggregate metadata audit, source manifest and reproducible eligibility or feasibility determination.
acceptance: Separate donor, biopsy, cell, library and contributing-study denominators.
Record the support for comparability and technical overlap or explain where the released tables stop.
